definitions.explanation: The act of making something stronger or more powerful by adding to it. Often used for military forces, organizational capacity, or systems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦力|せんりょく}→戦力：18977_senryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{増強|ぞうきょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦セキュリティ→セキュリティ：04867_sekyuriti⟧⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{増強|ぞうきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Strengthening of the security system is being demanded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{増強|ぞうきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: In preparation for disasters, they are working to strengthen the disaster prevention system.

notes:
{増強|ぞうきょう} means to increase strength or capacity by adding more of something — people, equipment, resources, or capability.

FORMS:
{増|ぞう} (increase) + {強|きょう} (strengthen).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{戦力|せんりょく}→戦力：18977_senryoku⟧{増強|ぞうきょう}: force reinforcement
- ⟦{軍備|ぐんび}→軍備：22011_gunbi⟧{増強|ぞうきょう}: military buildup
- ⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{増強|ぞうきょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to strengthen a system
- ⟦{人員|じんいん}→人員：17843_jinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{増強|ぞうきょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to increase personnel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧: strengthening (more general and common in everyday use)
- ⟦{補強|ほきょう}→補強：14024_hokyou⟧: reinforcement (often physical structures or adding support)
- {拡充|かくじゅう}: expansion and enhancement (broadening scope)
